title: EE60024: Power System Dynamics And Control
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Basic Ideas Modeling of Synchronous machines, excitation systems and GovernorsSteady state, Dynamic and Transient stability. State space formulation of
single and multi-machine models with control equipments. Damping effects of
FACTS devices. SSR. Application of numerical techniques to multi-machine
dynamic and transient stability studies. Generation/Frequency Characteristics
and load frequency characteristics, tie-line bias control, Automatic Generation
Control, Alert and emergency system operation control. Control of reactive
power flow: AVR, OLTC Transformers, FACTS, Static var compensators, system loss
minimization.
